desc: Read input and build the adjacency list.
Implement DFS to compute subtree sizes and leaf costs for each branch relative to a center.
Iterate over each vertex as the center of the Snowflake Tree.
For each center, compute the branches (neighbors' subtrees).
For each branch, compute the sorted list of costs to become leaves.
For each possible $y$, compute the total kept vertices for the center.
Track the maximum kept vertices over all centers and $y$.
